title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: and
text:
and
and
(definition)
Definition:
Conjunction: 0 AND 0 = 0, 0 AND 1 = 0, 1 AND 0 = 0, 1 AND 1 = 1.
See also
xor
,
nand
,
or
,
not
,
implies
.
